newsitem.title: PERU: Peru forces storm residence, some hostages freed.
newsitem.headline: Peru forces storm residence, some hostages freed.

text.p: Peruvian security forces stormed the Japanese ambassador's residence in Lima on Tuesday and more than 40 hostages were seen being led from the building by troops.
An explosion was heard and smoke billowed out of the residence where Marxist rebels have been holding 72 hostages in the building, which they stormed on Dec. 17.
At least 15 soldiers wearing masks made the initial assault on the building.
Witnesses said two explosions and gunfire were also heard at the diplomatic compound as security forces swarmed in.
Peru's Foreign Minister Francisco Tudela was carried out alive on a stretcher, witnesses said. Other hostages were seen clambering to freedom from the roof of the building.
